📝

Files & vision, built in

Users attach images, PDFs, and documents to a chat or form — and your agent reads them. Vision works across every LLM, with native PDF passthrough.

Agents that collaborate — with each other, and with people

Wire one agent into another's Tools port and it becomes an orchestrator, delegating to specialist sub-agents and combining their results — with tool-calling across every major provider.

Multi-agent team — a Director delegating across Mistral, Gemini & Claude

Orchestrator + sub-agents

Wire an agent into another's Tools port to delegate sub-tasks and combine results.

Multi-provider tool-calling

Tool-calling across Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama, Mistral, and OpenRouter — no longer one provider only.

Reach where work happens

Agents act through email, SMS, Slack, calendars, and search via native tools.

HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP

Pause, ask a person, resume exactly where it left off

With Slack “Send and Wait for Response,” an agent posts its draft, waits for a teammate to Approve or Revise, and continues the run — with automatic timeouts for anything left unanswered.

Meet users on WhatsApp & SMS

A continuous, stateful conversation over Twilio — the same agent and memory as your hosted chat. Each contact keeps a thread, and inbound photos become vision the agent can see.

Connected to your knowledge

Point Agent Knowledge at OneDrive and SharePoint folders, choose subfolders, set an auto-refresh interval, and sync — your agents answer from documents that stay current.

VERSIONING & DEPLOY

Ship to production safely

Edit a draft without touching what's live, then publish a clean, restorable version that your production webhooks, schedules, and triggers run.

  • Draft → publish versioning with one-click restore to any prior version
  • A dedicated webhook Test URL that fires your unpublished draft
  • Watch a test run light up node-by-node, live on the canvas
  • Production webhooks, schedules, and triggers run your published version
Version history — draft v2 while v1 stays live

AI Wingman — intelligence inside every workflow

Falcon Builder is the first workflow platform with an AI assistant that understands your workflow in real-time. Describe what you need — Wingman makes it happen.

Context-aware

Wingman sees every node, edge, and configuration in your workflow. No copy-pasting context.

Operation diffs

Changes are proposed as reviewable operations — add nodes, update configs, connect edges. Apply or dismiss each one.

Conversation memory

Wingman remembers your conversation per workflow. Pick up where you left off after a refresh.

Frequently asked questions

Quick answers for launch — expand as you add features.

Do I have to use AI to build agents?

No. You can build manually or start from templates. The AI Agent Generator and AI Workflow Generator are optional tools that accelerate creation.

What happens if I run out of AI Generator credits?

You can keep building manually, use templates, or connect your own LLM API for unlimited AI generation (tokens billed to your provider).

Do you resell or mark up tokens?

No markup on tokens you bring yourself. With BYOK (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Ollama), Wingman uses your key directly and your provider bills the tokens. Falcon Builder also offers its own AI Generator credits and Wingman tokens — included with every plan, with credit packs and auto-replenish at published rates.

How are executions counted?

Each time a workflow runs counts as one execution. Your plan includes a monthly execution allowance.
